article.title: 工具補讀：Affinity登陸iPad，核心設計工具免費、AI另需付費方案
article.title_en: Tool review: Affinity reaches iPad with free core tools and premium AI
article.summary: 11月2日報道介紹Affinity for iPad，把草圖、向量、修圖與排版放進同一檔案。
article.summary_en: November 2 reporting describes Affinity for iPad bringing sketching, vectors, photo editing and layout into one file.
highlights: 個人核心工具免費，使用App仍需免費Canva帳戶。
Canva AI Studio需premium帳戶，包含擴圖及拆分圖層等功能。
highlights_en: Core tools are free for individuals; a free Canva account is still required.
Canva AI Studio needs a premium account, with expansion and layer decomposition among its tools.
article.why: 外出工作的設計團隊可評估單一檔案流程，減少多個App之間的素材交接。
article.why_en: Mobile creative teams can evaluate a shared-file workflow for fewer handoffs between apps.
article.next_step: 先用現有品牌檔測試字體、圖層及匯出，再決定是否需要AI方案。
article.next_step_en: Test brand files, fonts, layers and export before deciding whether premium AI is needed.
article.detail: 官方確認草圖、向量、像素編輯及多頁排版可在同一個.af檔案工作，並為觸控及Apple Pencil設計介面。AI功能屬另一項資格：Generative Expand可延伸畫面，Decompose Layer可把平面圖像分成可編輯圖層。免費核心工具不等於全部功能免付費，也不代表iPad與桌面每項功能完全相同。本報未測試輸出品質，正式製作仍需核對原檔與印刷規格。
article.detail_en: Canva confirms a shared .af file and an interface built for touch and Apple Pencil. AI expansion and layer decomposition require separate premium eligibility. Free core tools do not mean every feature is free or identical to desktop. Production files and print output still need checking.
